text:
The bug is in `toolz/itertoolz.py`, function `sliding_window`, specifically line 670:

```python
itertools.islice(it, i)
```

The `tee` iterators are enumerated starting at 1, so each iterator is advanced by `i` elements before `zip` begins. This skips the first element of the first iterator and causes the first window to be omitted.

I will change the slice count to `i - 1`, so the iterators are offset by `0, 1, ..., n - 1`. This preserves empty and short-input behavior while producing one window for an input of exactly length `n`.
